axis: C1 calibration (7->7) - promisor metadata vs unavailable evidence
claim: A commit citation whose object exists locally but is not in the branch closure (and, for X1, not in any ref closure) stays RESOLVABLE. Promisor metadata alone must not turn a locally complete lane into exit 2.
discriminates: object-existence-based citation resolution (cat-file) vs reachability-based resolution (rev-list of the branch, or of all refs)

expected.name: P01-unreachable-citation-full
expected.description: Lane without promisor metadata. Cited commits C1 (on master), C2 (on master), X1 (dangling: no ref anywhere), X2 (reachable only via refs/keep/x2, outside the master closure).
expected.rationale: All four citations resolve by object existence. No round-1 lane commit on master is uncited, so no landed-omitted. This arm must be identical before and after the repair.

expected.name: P02-unreachable-citation-promisor
expected.description: The same lane, marked promisor by config only (extensions.partialClone=origin, remote.origin.promisor=true, remote.origin.partialclonefilter=blob:none) with every object still present locally and no promisor pack.
expected.rationale: Promisor metadata is a declaration, not evidence of incompleteness. Content completeness and availability of required evidence determine the outcome, so this arm must match P01 exactly (same substantive clean findings, not exit 2).

before_repair.note: This is the r23 harm the round-24 repair removes; it is recorded here as the pre-repair observation, not as an expectation.
